AnimatedTextKit.doc: Base class for Animated Text widgets.

animatedTexts.doc: List of [AnimatedText] to display subsequently in the animation.

pause.doc: Define the [Duration] of the pause between texts

displayFullTextOnTap.doc: Should the animation ends up early and display full text if you tap on it?

stopPauseOnTap.doc: If on pause, should a tap remove the remaining pause time ?

onTap.doc: Adds the onTap [VoidCallback] to the animated widget.

onNext.doc: Adds the onNext callback to the animated widget.

onNextBeforePause.doc: Adds the onNextBeforePause callback to the animated widget.

onFinished.doc: Adds the onFinished [VoidCallback] to the animated widget.

controller.doc: A controller for managing the state of an animated text sequence.

isRepeatingAnimation.doc: Set if the animation should not repeat by changing the value of it to false.

totalRepeatCount.doc: Sets the number of times animation should repeat

repeatForever.doc:
Sets if the animation should repeat forever. [isRepeatingAnimation] also
needs to be set to true if you want to repeat forever.

notes: onNext: 2 callback args cross as one array payload
onNextBeforePause: 2 callback args cross as one array payload

TextLiquidFill.doc:
Animation that displays a [text] element, coloring it to look like sloshing
water is filling it up.

text.doc: String which would be filled by liquid animation

loadDuration.doc: Specifies the duration the text should fill with liquid.

waveDuration.doc: Specifies the duration that one wave takes to pass the screen.

boxHeight.doc: Specifies the height of the box around text

boxWidth.doc: Specifies the width of the box around text

boxBackgroundColor.doc: Specifies the backgroundColor of the box

waveColor.doc: Specifies the color of the wave

loadUntil.doc:
Specifies the load limit: (0, 1.0].  This may be used to limit the liquid
fill effect to less than 100%.

BlurStyle.doc: Styles to use for blurs in [MaskFilter] objects.

ColorSpace.doc: The color space describes the colors that are available to an [Image].

FontStyle.doc: Whether to use the italic type variation of glyphs in the font.

TextAlign.doc: Whether and how to align text horizontally.

TextBaseline.doc: A horizontal line used for aligning text.

TextDecorationStyle.doc: The style in which to draw a text decoration

TextDirection.doc: A direction in which text flows.

TextOverflow.doc: How overflowing text should be handled.

AlignmentGeometry.doc:
Base class for [Alignment] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

AnimatedText.doc: Abstract base class for text animations.

Color.doc: An immutable color value in ARGB format.

Curve.doc:
An parametric animation easing curve, i.e. a mapping of the unit interval to
the unit interval.

Duration.doc: A difference between points in time.

FontFeature.doc: A feature tag and value that affect the selection of glyphs in a font.

FontVariation.doc: An axis tag and value that can be used to customize variable fonts.

FontWeight.doc: The thickness of the glyphs used to draw the text.

Locale.doc: An identifier used to select a user's language and formatting preferences.

Paint.doc: A description of the style to use when drawing on a [Canvas].

Rect.doc:
An immutable, 2D, axis-aligned, floating-point rectangle whose coordinates
are relative to a given origin.

TextDecoration.doc: A linear decoration to draw near the text.

TextStyle.doc: An immutable style describing how to format and paint text.
